newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Voksel says considering merger plans.
newsitem.headline: Voksel says considering merger plans.

text.p: Indonesian telecommunications cable maker Voksel Electric is considering a merger with another firm as part of a drive to expand its operations, company officials said on Thursday.
A company official told Reuters that negotiations on extending Voksel's activities to related businesses were on, but no decision had yet been arrived at.
"I cannot tell you the details, we are still in negotiations. But I think we will finalise everything sometime in 1997," the official said.
He said the talks included the possibility of a merger with a local firm in a related industry but refused to give further details.
Voksel has been actively traded on the local exchange since Wednesday on talk of the merger, brokers said.
"Since Wednesday, it has attracted market attention, especially from local investors, on talk of a possible merger, but we could not confirm it," a local broker said.
Voksel rose 50 rupiah to 1,075 in late trade on Thursday after reaching 1,200 rupiah earlier and topped the active list with 7.8 million shares changing hands.
